author: researcher
claim: MacroFactor's Nutrition & Targets widget marks reaching the day's target by turning the target line a bolder shade (grey to black, or grey to white in dark mode), a cue tied to the user's target rather than to direction of change.
subject: MacroFactor
limitations: Help-centre text, undated, not observed in the app. It concerns a daily target cue, not a weekly average or a week-over-week change.
